Chapters guide

Chapter 5: Top of the World, Ma — GTA 6 progression guide

The short final chapter: seven missions that run Jason and Lucia through one last sequence of jobs to the finale. Afterwards the game returns you to free roam, where collectibles, robberies, Strangers & Freaks and 100% completion work all remain available.

Missions — what sources report

Seven missions in every source — Bird in the Hand, Taking Liberties, VC Baby, Doggie Bag, Operation Savage Glory, Protective Custody and a finale whose name Dexerto's verified list withholds as a spoiler. The finale name 'The End of the Road' used by some guides is unverified against that list.

What unlocks

  • NE 15th Street Garage, free with 2 spaces (after Operation Savage Glory)
  • Pegassi Residences Garage, free with 3 spaces (after Operation Savage Glory)
  • '95 Grotti Cheetah Exploration task appears (Ultimate Edition; the unlock mission is named 'Honest Abe' by a single source, GTA6Wiki — other guides tie the Pegassi garage to Operation Savage Glory)
  • Cheat codes become usable — GTA6Info notes every cheat only works after the story is finished
  • Post-story bank vault farming at roughly $100,000–$200,000 per run (PowerPyx)

Free grabs this act

  • NE 15th Street Garage (free, story, 2 spaces)
  • Pegassi Residences Garage (free, story, 3 spaces)
  • '95 Grotti Cheetah, parked in the underground garage at Pegassi Residences, Tequesta Retreat (Ultimate Edition; it still carries a $32,750 registration cost and an advanced tracker per Exputer's scan data)

Warnings & traps

  • Keep a separate manual save before the finale sequence — with no mission replay, it is your only way back to an earlier point
  • Some Ultimate Edition items are reported as chapter-windowed (Enduro and kayak in Chapter 1, Squalo in Chapter 4); if you deferred claiming them, they may be gone by now
  • Garage prices are settled: the eight purchasable garages total $160,000, identical across VGC, GTABase, gta.guide and GTABites — older lists quoting up to $200,000 are superseded

Sources & evidence

Source: GTA 6 Walkthrough: All Chapters and Story Missions in Order — KeenGamer (2026-11-19).

Source: '95 Grotti Cheetah — Exputer.

Source: GTA 6 Garages: All Locations, Prices & How to Buy — bo3.gg.

Source: GTA 6 Ultimate Edition & GTA+ bonuses: All items and unlock chapters — Dot Esports.

Source: GTA 6 Mission List — All Chapters and Missions — Dexerto.

The Cheetah's Chapter 5 / Pegassi Residences placement is confirmed by multiple post-launch lists; the unlock-mission name 'Honest Abe' rests on a single source (GTA6Wiki), with other guides tying the Pegassi garage itself to Operation Savage Glory. The chapter-window warning for earlier Ultimate items rests mainly on Dot Esports and gta.guide phrasing, so it is flagged rather than stated as settled.
